run_maketable_script: run the maketable script to generate a CSV table and scatter plot from experiment MSE data files
review_maketable_script: review the maketable script that reads mse_*.txt files and produces a performance CSV and plot
refactor_maketable_paths: refactor the maketable script to accept experiment paths and camera IDs via command-line arguments

refactor_maketable_plot: refactor the maketable script to parameterize plot title, axis labels, and output filename
